descriptionHtml:
This One Shoulder Pleated Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress with Sleeves combines elegance and modern style. The pleated chiffon fabric flows beautifully, creating a graceful silhouette. The one-shoulder design adds a touch of sophistication, while the long sleeves provide a balanced, flattering look. Perfect for bridesmaids who want both comfort and style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper on the side.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
